Why this course matters

Your Journey to Appointment

You are preparing to take on responsibilities in a regulated financial services environment. This course is not only about remembering rules. It is about understanding the decisions and behaviours expected of you before you are appointed.

Why Is This Important?

During this course, you will explore:

That trust is why appointment readiness matters. You need the right knowledge, but you must also be able to apply it in your day-to-day decisions.

  • Identify the responsibilities of Representatives and Key Individuals.
  • Explain ‘Fit and Proper’ status and ‘good standing’.
  • Recognise and disclose interests that may create a conflict.
  • Follow approved scripts, policies and processes.
  • Understand conduct that may lead to disciplinary action or debarment.

By understanding these topics, you can make informed decisions, support fair Customer outcomes, and help maintain the integrity of TFG Insure's financial services business.

Why Does Appointment Readiness Matter?

You now understand why appointment readiness matters and how it helps protect Customers, your career, and TFG Insure.

Next, you will explore the different responsibilities of Representatives and Key Individuals. As you continue, think about the role you are preparing for and the actions you will need to take to work responsibly in a regulated financial services environment.
